# Codul civil din 26 noiembrie 1864

Codul civil din 1864 · 8 versions, from 1865-12-01 (latest in force: 2013-02-15) · <https://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocument/1>

| Provision | File | Changes | Last changed |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |

Act id: `codul-civil-1864` (tags `codul-civil-1864/<day>`; `python tools/on.py <day> codul-civil-1864`).

## Decisions made by hand

- Codul civil din 1864: added 2026-11-02, one of the Portalul legislativ's consolidated forms per version, as for the other acts. A capture was used only if it was complete and the page showed the form its document id stands for. The forms are those listed by DetaliiDocumentAfis/1 as captured on 2025-09-11, the newest capture of any of the act's pages: 5 forms, 5 held.
- Codul civil din 1864: the newest form held is that of 01.09.2011; amendments in force after it may be missing.
- Codul civil din 1864: the first version is the code as published (DetaliiDocumentAfis/1: arts. 1-347 in Monitorul Oficial nr. 271 of 4 December 1864, arts. 348-1.914 in nr. 7, 8, 9, 11 and 13 of 1865), in force on 1 December 1865, the day the portal and the code's editions give for its entry into force. Git cannot store a date before 1970: that commit is dated 1 January 1970 and its In-force trailer gives the real day.
- Codul civil din 1864: the portal holds no consolidated form before that of 1 September 1996 (the text of the Ministry of Justice edition of 1981, with references updated to 1 September 1996, its note says). So every change made from 1865 to 1996, and the move from the spelling of 1864 to today's, arrives on 1 September 1996, credited to the publisher where no note names the act.
- Codul civil din 1864: the code as published leaves out arts. 601 and 955 and prints art. 1.379 as "Articolul 1397" (between arts. 1.378 and 1.380) and the text of art. 510 inside its title; the form of 1996 prints art. 1.004 as "Articolul 100". Each misprinted number is read as the article it stands for; arts. 601 and 955 first appear on 1 September 1996.
- Codul civil din 1864: the forms print groups of repealed articles under one title ("Articolul 21-86", "Articolul 1371 - 1387."); each article in the group gets that one text, also when the form prints it as the paragraph right after the empty title ("(Abrogate prin art. 4 al Legii contra cametei din 2.IV.1931).", form of 1996).
- Codul civil din 1864: the 1996 note on art. 820 names "Legea privitoare la ridicarea incapacității civile a femeii măritate - promulgată prin Decretul nr. 1412, Monitorul Oficial nr. 94 din 20 aprilie 1932"; 94 is the gazette's number, not the law's, so no "Legea nr. 94/1932" is credited and the change that day is the publisher's. Other notes that a later act changed an article "implicitly" are kept as the portal gives them.
- Codul civil din 1864: arts. 1.824-1.836 (Titlul XIX, Despre expropriațiunea silită) were repealed by art. VIII of OUG nr. 138/2000, read as published (DetaliiDocumentAfis/24428), on the day that ordinance took effect: its art. IX, as OUG nr. 290/2000 rewrote it (read as published, DetaliiDocumentAfis/25814), puts it in force 7 months after its publication in Monitorul Oficial nr. 479 of 2 October 2000, so 2 May 2001, after the form of 1 May 2001 (which still prints them) and before that of 18 June 2002 (which leaves them out). The repeal is a version of its own on 2 May 2001.
- Codul civil din 1864: the portal's form of 1 October 2011 prints every article's text with a note that it is repealed from that day, so it is not read. The repeal is read from Legea nr. 71/2011 as published (DetaliiDocumentAfis/129268): its art. 230 lit. a) repeals the code on the day the new Civil Code takes effect, 1 October 2011, save arts. 1.169-1.206 (proof of obligations), which it repeals when Legea nr. 134/2010 privind Codul de procedură civilă takes effect: 15 February 2013 (art. 81 alin. (1) of Legea nr. 76/2012 as last amended before that day by OUG nr. 4/2013, the day part 9z-legea-76-2012 records). The record ends with two versions removing those articles, each credited to Legea nr. 71/2011.
- Codul civil din 1864: some forms print a wrong article number that repeats an earlier article's, between the two articles it sits between; Lexifina's code files it under the number in sequence: "Articolul 100" read as art. 1004, "Articolul 1337" read as art. 1338, "Articolul 1397" read as art. 1379, "Articolul 1491" read as art. 1498, "Articolul 1886" read as art. 1856, "Articolul 895" read as art. 985.
- Codul civil din 1864: the portal editorial notes printed as paragraphs of an article (on a Constitutional Court ruling, a rectification, a provision put back in force) are not text: 106 such paragraphs across all forms, for example «* Acte de executare.», «* Acțiune penală.», «* Apeductele.».
